headline: Meta’s Muse AI Assistant Rolled Out With a Serious Security Flaw
context: Meta says it issued a fix for the Muse zero-day vulnerability that would have let attackers do “whatever” they wanted on a victim’s Mac, highlighting the inherent dangers of AI helpers.
